info.title: Exende Jobs & Hiring Data API
info.description: Customer read API and restricted public catalogue proof. Jobs Data uses scoped organization API keys and credits; Callback, Retry and Resolve x402 contracts are separate. This contract documents the current implementation, including route-specific pagination limits and legacy supplementary response fields.

get.description: q is required. Search uses bounded, safely quoted FTS prefix terms. Keyset pagination: default 50, max 100. Ordered by last_seen_at DESC, id DESC. Pass nextCursor as cursor with unchanged filters. Concurrent catalogue updates mean this is not a frozen snapshot. Credit cost: 1 per returned record. Required scope: jobs:read.
get.x-pagination: Keyset pagination: default 50, max 100. Ordered by last_seen_at DESC, id DESC. Pass nextCursor as cursor with unchanged filters. Concurrent catalogue updates mean this is not a frozen snapshot.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size. Missing or invalid numeric values fall back to 50; the response never exceeds 100 records.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Trimmed FTS prefix query across title, department and description. Terms are combined with AND; at least one term must have two letters or numbers. Not a company or city search.

parameters.description: Exact canonical company ID.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Company domain normalized by the API.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Case-insensitive source location substring; SQL LIKE % and _ wildcards retain their current meaning.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: ISO alpha-2 country, case-insensitive; normalized to uppercase.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Case-insensitive job-title substring; SQL LIKE wildcards retain their current meaning.

parameters.name: skill
parameters.description: Normalized skill slug or recognized alias. Unknown skill returns an empty page.

parameters.name: employmentType
parameters.description: Normalized employment type.

parameters.name: workplaceType
parameters.description: Normalized workplace type.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Current canonical job status.

parameters.name: firstSeenAfter
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound on first_seen_at.

parameters.name: publishedAfter
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound on the source posted_at timestamp; missing publication dates do not match.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque nextCursor from the previous response. Preserve all other filters.

get.description: Aggregate-only public proof. No key and no credits. No listing, customer, or source-health records. Last updated is the latest canonical job observation.

429.description: Too many requests. Retry after 60 seconds.

get.summary: Search the limited public catalogue preview
get.description: Deterministic AND terms over public title, department, source location, company name/domain and normalized skills; exact country names and supported country codes filter country_code directly; skill aliases are recognized. Only q is accepted. No pagination or export. Sample membership is fixed by migration, with at most 12 enrolled jobs across all queries; responses contain at most 5. Full descriptions, source payloads, customer and operator data are excluded. Aggregates describe matching active canonical jobs, not just samples. Limits: public gateway 20 requests/minute per client IP and Data Plane 60/minute; Cloudflare limits are approximate.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Up to 80 characters and 6 terms; at least 2 characters when nonempty. Omit for catalogue-wide aggregates and the fixed sample. Control characters, wildcard-only queries and duplicate q are rejected. NFKC-normalized, case-insensitive.

400.description: Invalid query, duplicate q, extra parameters, or extraction controls.

429.description: Preview rate limit exceeded. Retry after 60 seconds.

503.description: The preview or required limiter is unavailable.

200.description: Real matching aggregates and up to 5 enrolled samples. No matches returns zero counts and empty arrays. Matches can exist without any enrolled sample.

CustomerKey.description: Organization API key from the Exende dashboard. Scopes are declared on each operation.

canonical_domain.description: Canonical company domain; not an ATS hostname.

location.description: Source location text; not a normalized city identifier.

country_code.description: ISO alpha-2 country only when explicit evidence supports normalization; otherwise null.

source_url.description: Public listing URL retained for attribution.

first_seen_at.description: First Exende observation, not necessarily publication.

last_seen_at.description: Most recent canonical observation; unchanged visibility is capped at once per UTC day.

nextCursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor, or null when there is no further page.

history_complete.description: The earliest immutable version reaches the requested window start. This is a readiness gate, not proof of uninterrupted or whole-market coverage.
